title: 第23章 暗潮涌动第24章 无缺武道元神
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
江海市的夜晚，浓云如墨般笼罩着整个江海，万籁俱寂。
在这座繁华都市，矗立着一座宏伟壮丽、金碧辉煌且极尽奢华的酒店。
酒店高耸入云，直插夜空，而在它那最顶层的天台之上，正站立着一位身着，剪裁精致西装的年轻男子。
这位男子面容俊美，嘴角微微上扬，带着一抹邪意，他手中轻握着一杯红酒，优雅地轻轻晃动着酒杯。
男子俯瞰着下方江海市，璀璨夺目的辉煌夜景，他很快便收了回来，淡淡地开口问道：“那个女人没有答应吗？”
一直静静地站在他身旁的，侍从恭敬地回答道：“大人，据属下所知，她说与大人分属不同，不愿插手此事。”
听到侍从的禀报，俊美男子微微挑眉，脸上绽放出，一抹略带嘲讽的笑容，轻声说道：“真是个可悲的女人，身处我们这个行当，怜悯之心只会害了你。”
他顿了顿，目光再次投向远方的黑暗，似乎透过重重夜幕，看到了那个倔强的女子。
女人啊！那位之所以没有动你，是因为你尚有利用价值罢了，你所坚持的东西，在上位者的眼中，根本就是一文不值。
俊美男子的眼神变得冷厉起来，冷冷地道：“既然她不肯答应帮忙，那我们就自己动手好了。”
侍从闻言不禁面露难色道：“大人，如果没有当地势力的协助，恐怕我们很难凑齐，所需的数量，而且这可能会引起官方的警觉。”
俊美男子眼神阴寒道：“江海阴暗沟里有的是老鼠，那些人失踪没人会在意。”
在那深不见底的地底之下，隐藏着一座规模宏大且，令人毛骨悚然的地下空间。
这座空间偶尔会传出一声声凄厉至极、惨绝人寰的嚎叫声，让人闻之胆寒。
在这个充满诡异气氛的地方，有一间完全封闭的房间。
房间内摆放着各式各样的实验器具，这些器具散发出一股刺鼻的味道。
而此时，一个身穿洁白大褂的金发碧眼老人正静静地站立其中。
这位老人神情专注地摆弄着，手中的实验器具，他的眼神时而闪烁出疯狂的光芒，透露出一种近乎癫狂的状态。
在他身前不远处，立着一根透明的玻璃柱子，里面灌满绿色的不明液体。
这绿色液体之中浸泡着，一具年幼的小女孩尸体！她紧闭双眼，面色苍白如纸，身躯在液体中微微漂浮着，宛如沉睡中的幽灵。

突然间，一阵尖锐刺耳、如同夜枭般沙哑的声音从黑暗的阴影处传来：“我给你弄来了这么多实验体，我的东西呢？”
听到这突如其来的质问，金发老人的身体猛地一颤，随后他缓缓扭过头来，脸上浮现出扭曲而癫狂的笑容：“你还是这么没有礼貌啊，嘿嘿嘿……，目前实验所需的耗材，已经所剩无几，所以你最好还是再多准备一些。”
话音刚落，只见老人伸手入怀，掏出了两个小巧玲珑的瓶子。
这两个瓶子中盛装着，一种神秘的紫色液体，在昏暗的光线下折射出奇异的光芒。
紧接着，他将这两个瓶子朝着阴影所在的方向甩去。
刹那间，从阴影中伸出一只手，精准无误地接住了飞射而来的小瓶。
随后，那道沙哑的声音再次响起：“如今黑衣卫已经开始全面戒严，想要弄到实验人体很难，但既然答应了你，我尽量想办法再帮你弄一些过来的。”
content_en:
At night in Jianghai City, thick clouds covered the entire Jianghai like ink, and everything was silent.
In this bustling city, stands a magnificent, splendid and extremely luxurious hotel.
The hotel towers into the night sky, and on its top rooftop stands a young man wearing a finely tailored suit.
The man had a handsome face, and the corners of his mouth were slightly raised, with a hint of evil intent. He held a glass of red wine in his hand and shook the glass gracefully.
The man looked down at the dazzling night scene of Jianghai City. He quickly took it back and asked calmly: "Didn't that woman agree?"
The attendant, who had been standing quietly beside him, replied respectfully: "My lord, as far as I know, she said that she belongs to a different family than your lord and does not want to interfere in this matter."
Upon hearing the attendant's report, the handsome man raised his eyebrows slightly, a slightly sarcastic smile appeared on his face, and said softly: "What a pathetic woman. In our industry, compassion will only harm you."
He paused and looked towards the darkness in the distance again, seeming to see the stubborn woman through the darkness.
Woman! The reason why that person didn't touch you is because you still have value. What you insist on is worthless in the eyes of the superior.
The handsome man's eyes became cold and stern, and he said coldly: "Since she refuses to agree to help, then we can do it ourselves."
The attendant couldn't help but look embarrassed when he heard this and said: "Sir, without the assistance of local forces, I am afraid it will be difficult for us to gather the required quantity, and this may arouse official alert."
The handsome man said with cold eyes: "There are many rats in the dark ditches of the rivers and seas. No one will care about the disappearance of those people."
Under the bottomless ground, there is a large and creepy underground space hidden.
Occasionally, extremely sad and cruel howls can be heard from this space, which makes people feel horrified to hear them.
In this place full of weird atmosphere, there is a completely closed room.
There were various experimental equipment placed in the room, and these equipment gave off a pungent smell.
At this time, an old man with blond hair and blue eyes wearing a white coat was standing quietly among them.
The old man was fiddling with the experimental equipment in his hands with concentration, and his eyes sometimes flashed with crazy light, revealing an almost crazy state.
Not far in front of him, stood a transparent glass pillar filled with an unknown green liquid.
Soaked in this green liquid was the body of a young girl! She closed her eyes tightly, her face was as pale as paper, and her body was floating slightly in the liquid, like a sleeping ghost.
Suddenly, a sharp, harsh voice, as hoarse as a night owl, came from the dark shadows: "I got so many experimental subjects for you, where are my things?"
Hearing this sudden question, the blond old man's body trembled, and then he slowly turned his head, with a twisted and crazy smile on his face: "You are still so rude, hehehe... There are not many consumables left for the experiment, so you'd better prepare more."
As soon as he finished speaking, the old man reached into his arms and took out two small and exquisite bottles.
These two bottles contained a mysterious purple liquid that reflected a strange light in the dim light.
Then, he threw the two bottles in the direction of the shadow.
In an instant, a hand stretched out from the shadows and accurately caught the flying vial.
Then, the hoarse voice sounded again: "Now that the black guards have begun full martial law, it is difficult to get experimental human bodies, but since I agreed to you, I will try my best to find some ways to help you get some more."
